senses.gloss: f. (חוֹר II) freedom, liberty, libertinism; leisure. Mekh. B’shall. s. 1, v. חִירָה.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 42a:14">Gitt. 42ᵃ</cite> <he>יצא לח׳</he> becomes free (<cite ref="Gittin 8b">ib. 8ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>בן חוֹרִין</he>).

Erub. 54ᵃ (play on חָרוּת, Ex. XXXII, 16) א״ת חרות אלא חי׳ read not ḥaruth (engraven) but ḥeruth (liberty) on the tablets (you are free, if you observe the law); Ex. R. s. 32, beg. ח׳ מן המלכיות liberation from political oppression, ח׳ ממלאך המות liberation from the angel of death (pestilence); a. fr.
